strings: Incapable of fighting of the fever, poor m_c has passed away in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest.
As the days pass m_c just gets weaker and weaker, eventually it's no shock when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} found dead in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest.
m_c died from the rat bite fever.

death.history: m_c died because of rat bite fever.
